about_the_game:
Trapped in a Nightmare. Hunted by the Unknown.

It’s been 3 months since your daughter vanished, and no one will tell you where she was last seen. The villagers are insane, the toxic weapon testers are heartless, and the silence is deafening. Just when hope seems lost, a cryptic message leads you to a photo of a house and a location. “Your daughter is probably here—but you’re on your own.”

🩸 Key Features 🩸

🕯 True Survival Horror
You're weak, vulnerable, and alone. Scavenge, craft, and adapt to survive in an ever-shifting nightmare where every decision could be your last.

🏚 Safehouses Aren’t Always Safe
Find shelter, but beware—nothing in this twisted village is ever as safe as it seems. The deeper you venture, the more dangerous the safehouses become. Someone—or something—is always watching.

🔦 Unlock Tools to Survive
Begin your journey with only a flashlight to guide you through the dark. As you progress, unlock night vision, masks, and more, but the more powerful your tools, the greater the horrors that will follow.

🧩 Unravel a Disturbing Mystery
The village hides unspeakable secrets. Solve puzzles, uncover cryptic clues, and piece together the truth behind the terrifying experiments that haunt this forsaken place.

🌫 Psychological Horror
As the poison warps your senses, fear distorts your reality. Hallucinations blur the line between nightmare and truth, leaving you questioning what’s real and what’s not.

🐀 Environmental Threats
Swarms of rats, twisting labyrinths, and unseen horrors lurk just beyond the corner of your vision. The world around you is alive—and it’s out to get you.

🎭 Immersive, Haunting Atmosphere
With stylized visuals, dynamic lighting, and a tense, ever-present soundscape, this game will immerse you in an experience that’ll leave you on edge from start to finish.

🔒 Unlockable Abilities
As you progress, unlock powerful new tools and abilities—but with each upgrade, the village becomes even more nightmarish. Can you survive the escalating horrors?

Wishlist now. The nightmare begins soon.

As a solo developer, I’m pouring everything I have into this game. Your feedback means the world to me, and I’m excited to share this terrifying experience with you. Help me make this game even better—your support is invaluable.

name: Project: Fractured Reality

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or macOS 11.0 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 280X with 4 GB VRAM or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or macOS 11.0 or later
  • Processor: 6-core Intel i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 processor
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (or better) with 6-8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Dedicated sound card or motherboard with high-quality audio support
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No

short_description: Project: Fractured Reality is a gripping survival horror experience. Trapped in a remote village twisted by toxic weapon experiments, you must find your missing daughter. Explore, craft, and survive. But once you leave the safehouse… you’re truly on your own.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
